2607.01962.title: NeoMap: Training-free Novel-View Synthesis from Single Images and Videos
2607.01962.paper_summary: We study the challenging problem of novel view video synthesis from single images or monocular videos. Existing methods, which operate under the assumption that pre-trained video models lack native novel view synthesis capability and enforce view alignment via camera conditioning, task-specific fine-tuning, or stepwise hard denoising guidance, often suffer from artifacts and compromised global scene consistency. In this paper, we introduce NeoMap, a novel training-free framework designed to locate high-fidelity, view-consistent novel view solutions from general pre-trained video models. The key to our approach is the core insight that promising novel view solutions are inherently encoded within the natural video data manifold learned by pre-trained models, and the core challenge is simply to locate this optimal solution. We solve this via our core mechanism: convergent manifold alternating projection iterations that optimize the initial noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeoMap significantly outperforms all existing methods across 3 standard novel view synthesis benchmarks, including the challenging Tanks-and-Temples, LLFF and DAVIS datasets, achieving state-of-the-art generation fidelity and top-tier view consistency.
2607.01962.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究從單一圖像或單眼視頻生成新視角視頻的挑戰性問題。現有的方法假設預訓練視頻模型缺乏原生的新視角合成能力，並通過相機條件、特定任務的微調或逐步的強硬去噪指導來強制視角對齊，這些方法往往會遭受伪影和全球場景一致性受損的問題。在本文中，我們介紹了NeoMap，一個無需訓練的新框架，旨在從通用的預訓練視頻模型中定位高保真、視角一致的新視角解決方案。我們方法的關鍵在於核心見解，即有前景的新視角解決方案本質上被編碼在預訓練模型學習的自然視頻數據流形中，而核心挑戰僅僅是定位這個最佳解決方案。我們通過我們的核心機制來解決這個問題：收斂流形交替投影迭代，優化初始噪聲。大量實驗表明，NeoMap在三個標準新視角合成基準上顯著超越所有現有方法，包括具有挑戰性的Tanks-and-Temples、LLFF和DAVIS數據集，實現了最先進的生成保真度和頂級的視角一致性。
